description_en: Calls the CreateVideoCompressTask operation to create a video compression and storage task. After the task is complete, a TaskId is returned
description_zh: 调用CreateVideoCompressTask接口创建一个视频压缩存储任务，执行完成后返回TaskId
kebab_example: aliyun imm create-video-compress-task --project immvideotest --video-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/video.mp4 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVideoCompressTask

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the video.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where `bucket` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and `object` is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
视频的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中`bucket`为和当前项目处于同一地域的OSS Bucket名称，`object`为文件路径
parameters.name: video_uri

parameters.help_en: The TopicName for asynchronous reverse notification
parameters.name: notify_topic_name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notification. The task execute status can be asynchronously notified to the caller through this endpoint. To use this feature, activate Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) first, create a topic and queue, and configure the subscription relationship. For more information, see Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) Quick Start (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html).

Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) and Intelligent Media Management must be in the same region
parameters.help_zh:
异步反向通知的Endpoint，任务执行状态可以通过该Endpoint异步通知给调用者。使用此功能需要先开通轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务，新建topic和queue，并配置订阅关系。具体操作，请参见轻量消息队列（原 MNS）快速入门 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/34412.html)。

轻量消息队列（原 MNS）服务和智能媒体管理必须处于同一地域
parameters.name: notify_endpoint

parameters.help_en: The list of compressed videos. You can compress the same video into multiple results in different formats simultaneously. For more information, see the TargetList parameter description
parameters.help_zh: 压缩后的视频列表。支持对同一视频同时压缩多份不同格式结果。更多信息，请参见TargetList参数说明
parameters.name: target_list

parameters.help_en: The custom information. When Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) notifies the task execute status, the content is returned as-is
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义的信息。在轻量消息队列（原 MNS）通知任务执行状态时，内容会原样返回
parameters.name: custom_message

parameters.help_en: Segmented transcoding. This parameter is not supported in the current version
parameters.help_zh: 分段转码。当前版本不支持此参数
parameters.name: target_segment

parameters.help_en: Extracts subtitles from the video. For more information, see the TargetSubtitle parameter description table
parameters.help_zh: 提取视频中的字幕。更多信息，请参见TargetSubtitle参数说明表格
parameters.name: target_subtitle

TaskType.description_en: The task type. The value is fixed as CompressVideoTask
TaskType.description_zh: 任务的类型，返回值固定为CompressVideoTask
